lines.sub: This is Lira's Academy, lesson thirty — “Lira for your company”.
lines.tts: This is Lira's Academy, lesson thirty — Lira for your company.

lines.sub: I have ten people, a website and a Telegram channel. I can't see who's doing what, leads get lost, and clients wait.
lines.tts: I have ten people, a website and a Telegram channel. I can't see who's doing what, leads get lost, and clients wait.

lines.sub: Let's put it all in one place. Half an hour of setup — and then your company runs itself.
lines.tts: Let's put it all in one place. Half an hour of setup — and then your company runs itself.

lines.sub: Studio, “Brain”, “Create company”. The company has one balance for everyone, and each employee has their own limit.
lines.tts: Studio, Brain, Create company. The company has one balance for everyone, and each employee has their own limit.

lines.sub: “Invite an employee”: a name and what they do. Send the link in a messenger. They open it on their phone — nothing to install.
lines.tts: Invite an employee: a name, and what they do. Send the link in a messenger. They open it on their phone — nothing to install.

lines.sub: Lira, tell Sergey to replace the wiring at the Ivanovs' by Friday.
lines.tts: Lira, tell Sergey to replace the wiring at the Ivanovs' by Friday.

lines.sub: Sergey taps “I'll take it”, then “Done” — with a photo. He can only reschedule with a reason. An hour before the deadline, I'll remind him myself.
lines.tts: Sergey taps I'll take it, then Done — with a photo. He can only reschedule with a reason. An hour before the deadline, I'll remind him myself.

lines.sub: And the board shows at a glance: who's doing what, what's waiting for your review, and what's overdue.
lines.tts: And the board shows at a glance: who's doing what, what's waiting for your review, and what's overdue.

lines.sub: I'll build the website from a description. In “Website chat”, I take the knowledge from your site in one click — prices, services, address.
lines.tts: I'll build the website from a description. In Website chat, I take the knowledge from your site in one click — prices, services, address.

lines.sub: The assistant answers clients day and night — on the site and in the company's Telegram bot, even when the computer is off.
lines.tts: The assistant answers clients day and night — on the site and in the company's Telegram bot, even when the computer is off.

lines.sub: A client left a phone number — a card appears in “Clients”, and the lead instantly becomes a task for an employee: get in touch within two hours.
lines.tts: A client left a phone number — a card appears in Clients, and the lead instantly becomes a task for an employee: get in touch within two hours.

lines.sub: The card shows what you agreed and the next step. Deals move from lead to payment, and who owes you is shown in red.
lines.tts: The card shows what you agreed and the next step. Deals move from lead to payment, and who owes you is shown in red.

lines.sub: Every Friday — the week in review: tasks given and done, who did how much, how many leads came in, and what's overdue.
lines.tts: Every Friday — the week in review: tasks given and done, who did how much, how many leads came in, and what's overdue.

lines.sub: And all of this from my phone?
lines.tts: And all of this from my phone?

lines.sub: From your phone: the same board — assign, accept, send back with a comment.
lines.tts: From your phone: the same board — assign, accept, send back with a comment.

lines.sub: And every day, I'm an assistant for everyone: I'll remind you of a meeting, sort your mail, find what you need in your documents. For the manager and for every employee — by voice, on the computer and on the phone.
lines.tts: And every day, I'm an assistant for everyone: I'll remind you of a meeting, sort your mail, find what you need in your documents. For the manager and for every employee — by voice, on the computer and on the phone.

lines.sub: Studio, “Brain”, “Create company” — then “Company launch” walks you through five steps with checkboxes.
lines.tts: Studio, Brain, Create company — then Company launch walks you through five steps with checkboxes.

lines.sub: See you in the next lesson!
